scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
^ff0000If you attempt to tame any monsters, it will not count as a kill. Please be careful.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
^ff0000請注意，馴服魔物不計入擊殺數。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Your base level is too low, come back when you hit level 60+.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
您的基礎等級太低了，請達到60級後再來。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Oh, a curious onlooker? I'm Marry Jae, the person in charge of weekends among the days of the week.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
哦，來湊熱鬧的嗎？我是瑪麗·傑，一週七天裡，週末歸我管。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
What is the weekend dungeon? Actually, it's a specially designed space for new adventurers to train.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
週末副本是什麼？其實就是專為新手冒險者設計的訓練場。

scripts.text: ^0000FFLooking around, it's obvious that Marry Jae is talking to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF環顧四周，很明顯瑪麗·傑正在和你說話。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
For those who do not have a party on the weekends, this place is hunting and experience gaining grounds for lonely adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
週末找不到隊友？這裡就是為孤身冒險者準備的狩獵練級場所！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Besides, the experience gain here is very generous.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
而且，這裡的經驗值十分豐厚。

scripts.text: When is the opening time?
scripts.translation: 開放時間是什麼時候？

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The dungeon will be open during:
^0000FFSaturday 00:00 ~ Sunday 23:59^000000

[Marry Jae]
I hope to see you when the weekend arrives~
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
期待週末與您相見~

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You need to form a party of one member or more.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
請先組建一支至少1人的隊伍。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Sorry, but the entry period to the Weekend Dungeon has expired.
Take a rest while waiting for the dungeon to be available again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
抱歉，週末副本的入場時間已結束。
請稍作休息，等待副本再次開放。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The cooldown has expired.
You may re-enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
冷卻結束，可以再次進入記憶副本了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
I think you're just about ready.
Now, would you like to enter it now?
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
我想您已經準備好了。
那麼，您現在要進入嗎？

scripts.text: Enter Weekend Dungeon
scripts.translation: 進入週末副本

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Prepare Memorial Dungeon
scripts.translation: 準備記憶副本

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The Memorial Dungeon has been created.
You may now enter.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
記憶副本已建立，現在可以進入了。

scripts.text: There is no Memorial Dungeon registered.
scripts.translation: 尚未登記記憶副本。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You have not prepared?
Can't really help it I guess.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗·傑]
您還沒有準備好嗎？
那我也沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
I offer packaging services for those who wish to present a precious gift to a cherished one.
scripts.translation:
[禮品供應職員]
想給珍視的人送一份好禮？我這裡提供禮品包裝服務。

我倒是可以替您選，不過每個人的實力不同，能應付的難度也不一樣。
